card.title: How To Fix iPhone That Is Bootlooping. iTunes Error Code 9

source.title: How To Fix iPhone That Is Bootlooping. iTunes Error Code 9

claims.statement: iPhone 7 bootloop with 3uTools Easy Flash failing at 19–20% and error 9 on iTunes flash needs a NAND replacement.
NANDs from iPhone 6S, 6S Plus, SE (1st gen), iPad Pro 9.7, 10.5, 12.9 gen 1/2 and iPad 5th–7th gen are interchangeable with iPhone 7 / 7 Plus.
Without original data, recover SN/MACs via GSX, MagicCFG after a checkra1n jailbreak, or JCID Drawing with JC P7 factory code query.

procedure: Test with known-good screen/port/battery and cable; flash with Easy Flash and iTunes Flash.
Read original NAND data (SN, Wi-Fi, BT).
Program a compatible NAND with JC P7 or iRepair P10.
Install and restore; recover data via query if needed.
